name: Rooted Face-Consistent Coupling Classes
summary: Ample classes admitting a joint law of rooted actual support selections, each satisfying every cube budget through dimension k, whose mean satisfies all cube budgets.
parameters: Integer k >= 1; level zero equals Frac. The fixed levels E_1 and E_2 have their own entries.
comments: The mean, joint law and root are existential and may be chosen anew. Closure under projection and conditioning is not assessed; failures of prescribed laws do not separate these classes.
